_README: EDIT PRICES HERE. Change a "from" number, save, then run: python3 tools/build-catalogue.py — the PDF rebuilds. To add a product, copy any block in "products". To remove one, delete its block or add "hide": true.

meta.title: Price List
meta.intro: Starting prices per piece in USD, excluding VAT and branding, at the minimum order quantity shown.
meta.disclaimer: Indicative starting prices. Final pricing depends on fabric, colour, quantity, branding and delivery date. Every order is quoted in writing before production.

steps: Send us the list — styles, rough quantities, colours and your deadline.
We quote in writing, with branding priced separately so you see what drives the total.
You approve a physical sample before anything is cut.
We deliver to an agreed date. Your spec stays on file, so the reorder is one message.
